metrics.instructions: Score every row from 1 to 5 using the same rubric as the judge: `python -m evals.calibrate --run-id full-20260912T011614Z`. That writes calibration_scores.csv. Then re-run `python -m evals.run --suite human_calibration --run-id full-20260912T011614Z`. You can also fill calibration_export.csv by hand. Do not open calibration_key.json until you are finished.
metrics.interpretation: Judge results are validated against human scoring at the stated targets.
